{{Top|leg}}
'''Vilas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] who was owned by [[Annileen Calwell]], a businesswoman who owned [[Dannar's Claim]]. After another dewback named [[Snit (dewback)|Snit]] escaped the compound with Annileen's teenage daughter [[Kallie Calwell]], Annileen rode after her daughter on Vilas. She managed to use Vilas to mount Snit but was unable to regain control of the unruly Snit. The fugitive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] managed to rescue Kallie with his [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]] mount [[Rooh]].<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
